effects: Pulls `amount` rETH (the vault collateral, 0xae78…6393) from the signer into the vault via transferFrom, which needs a prior approval.
Credits vault active shares, worth the deposited rETH, to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer.
Reverts if the depositor whitelist or deposit limit is active and blocks the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 rETH for a named beneficiary into the shown vault.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown; it comes from vault storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...). The descriptor has no shares field because the value is not in calldata.
findings.fix: None possible. The beneficiary and the rETH amount already describe the position.

effects: Burns enough of the signer's active vault shares to cover `amount` rETH, rounded up.
Moves `amount` rETH of stake into the next epoch's withdrawal queue. That stake can still be slashed until it is claimed.
Gives `claimer` the withdrawal shares, i.e. the right to claim the rETH after the epoch ends. No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of 2.5 rETH whose claim right belongs to the claimer address.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and the delay or slashing risk before claiming are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake()); _withdraw queues it at currentEpoch()+1, and onSlash can reduce withdrawals[epoch]. Descriptor intent: 'Request withdrawal'.
findings.fix: Optionally mention in the intent that funds can be claimed after the next epoch and remain slashable until then.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Moves the matching rETH value, computed from vault storage, into the next epoch's withdrawal queue. That stake can still be slashed.
Gives `claimer` the withdrawal shares, i.e. the right to claim that rETH after the epoch ends.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claimer address.

findings.title: redeem: shares are shown as a raw 18-decimal integer in both the intent and the field.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: '#.shares' format 'raw', label 'Vault shares (raw)'; case 2 shows 'Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the same 18 decimals as rETH.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {decimals: 18, base: 'shares'} so the value reads as 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the rETH amount being queued is derived from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());

effects: Sends the signer's full matured rETH withdrawal for `epoch` (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)) from the vault to `recipient`.
Marks the signer's withdrawal for that epoch as claimed, so it cannot be claimed again.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient address; the asset and amount are not named.

findings.title: claim: the screen never says that rETH is the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount); descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Name the asset: intent 'Claim rETH withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim rETH from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the rETH amount paid comes from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Sends the sum of the signer's matured rETH withdrawals for every listed epoch from the vault to `recipient`.
Marks each listed epoch as claimed for the signer.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient address; the asset and amount are not named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never says that rETH is the asset sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount); descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Name the asset: intent 'Claim rETH withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim rETH from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total rETH paid comes from storage and cannot be shown.
